title: RecommendationSystem RecSysV2LaunchEvaluation

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the RecSys-v2 launch evaluation research task. Generated comprehensive analysis code, statistical tests, visualizations, and a detailed model evaluation report. The report recommends NOT launching RecSys-v2 due to catastrophic diversity loss (-50.6% catalog coverage) and dramatic increase in user complaints (+187%), despite improvements in some engagement metrics. All deliverables are complete: analysis code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and final report with figures in report/.
